title: Mycelium Metabolism / Adaptive Calibration
goal: Re-admit the smallest safe Mycelium metabolism layer from proven OTHRYS stock and biological network principles so project-aware execution can grow, reinforce, hold or contract from measured conditions without inventing routes or authority.

work.problem: 010L can place multiple lanes, but it does not yet know when wider execution is beneficial, wasteful or dangerous for a specific project/workload.
out_of_scope: No worker launch or autonomous fan-out
No learned legality or route invention
No distributed CAS or persistent adaptive state
No hardware identity inside project manifests
No AI or opaque score for metabolism

laws: Run at the measured throughput knee, not the hardware redline.
Unknown telemetry is labeled, never fabricated.
Growth requires expected useful gain above marginal metabolic cost.
Stress may contract or quiesce topology but never change authority or legality.

slices.title: Truthful resource economy and marginal growth

tasks.title: Implement resource reports, metabolic modes and grow/hold/contract/quiesce decisions

slices.title: Biological harvest and real-node calibration proof

tasks.title: Prove hostile telemetry, measured-knee contraction and cross-node portability
